description: This file defines the SimpleFtpClient class, which implements FTP client operations such as connect, list files, set transfer mode, copy files, and close connection, using Apache Commons Net FTP library.

classes.name: SimpleFtpClient
classes.description: A class implementing FTP client functionalities such as connect, list, set transfer mode, switch modes, copy files, and disconnect, using Apache Commons FTP library.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection to the specified host with optional port and timeout, handling login and connection validation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory path on the FTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets the FTP transfer mode to binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Switches between passive and active FTP modes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Uploads a file to the specified directory on the FTP server.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the FTP connection if it is open.
